description: Régie des Transports BAAG - GTFS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'agglomération de la Baie de Somme. Urban transport network of the agglomeration of the Baie de Somme. In a few lines, the BAAG Buses are: 13 bus lines, including 3 urban lines and 10 school lines; 8 mini-buses, including 1 electric and 7 buses; 470 774 kilometres travelled in 2022; 546 school subscriptions, 270 annual subscriptions, 272 diamonds, 7977 monthly subscriptions ... Coverage: Communauté d'agglomération de la Baie de Somme. The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'agglomération de la Baie de Somme. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-12-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
